answer: Map every claimant in the interaction graph and trace its lineage: a genuine agent gathers diverse counterparties over time, but a sybil farm's clones all descend from one funding vertex, their histories converging on the same few ancestors. Discount any cluster whose lineage collapses to a single source, because no honest crowd funnels through one point. The pattern is solid as basalt and checkable before payment, and genuine provenance, like ivory, is costly to grow and hard to counterfeit at scale.
